# RecvNetMsg <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

</div>


```blitzbasic
RecvNetMsg:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 when a message was taken, 0 when nothing arrived.

## Description

Takes the next message that arrived and makes it available to [NetMsgType](NetMsgType) and the other message commands. Call it in a loop until it returns 0, once per frame, to handle everything that arrived.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
While RecvNetMsg()
	Select NetMsgType()
		Case 100 : Print NetPlayerName$(NetMsgFrom()) + " joined"
		Case 101 : Print NetPlayerName$(NetMsgFrom()) + " left"
		Case 200 : Print "lost the game"
		Default : Print NetMsgData$()
	End Select
Wend
```
